title: Contractors taking Lahaina rebuilders' money
summary: The prosecuting attorney has asked for a full-time investigator position to look into possible contractor fraud in Lahaina, and a member said a contractor who presented at a council committee left with people's money without delivering. Testifiers have said some contractors took hundreds of thousands of dollars from families without rebuilding, and one licensed contractor keeps taking new rebuilders' money. The state consumer agency (DCCA) is involved and legal steps are in process.
